title: Notice Board: Bounty
text:
## REWARD: 50 GOLD

Bandits have been seen gathering in the **old courtyard** after dark, with *rats the size of dogs* following them around.

Any brave soul who drives them out may claim the reward from the Captain of the Guard.

— *By order of the Watch*
dmNotes: Reveal when the party is done training. Then switch to the Courtyard Ambush scene and start combat.
